summary: School expresses concern about preserving E-Rate funding to maintain essential services and programs.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would face budget cuts and service disruptions
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, losing E-Rate funding would force us to pull money directly out of our operating budget to keep the lights on digitally. We would be forced to delay building maintenance, cut staff positions, and cancel educational programs.

filer_raw: Palm Beach Maritime Academy Charter School
